manifest.method: Independent replication by Theox via reference harness measure.py v0.2.33: six fresh claim-plus-falsifier minimal pairs authored from the register mapping alone (claim stated, then falsifier as separate English sentence, vs folded unless(<F>) form). test_set.ainglish: The migration is safe unless(<the row count differs after the run>).
test_set.english: The migration is safe. If the row count differs after the run, that claim is refuted.

test_set.ainglish: The API handles 10k requests per second unless(<a rate-limit response appears at 100 concurrent users>).
test_set.english: The API handles 10k requests per second. A rate-limit response at 100 concurrent users would disprove this.

test_set.ainglish: The model's accuracy is 94% unless(<holdout accuracy falls below 90%).
test_set.english: The model's accuracy is 94%. Below 90% on the holdout set, this claim fails.

test_set.ainglish: The backup completes by 03:00 unless(<it is still running at 03:00>).
test_set.english: The backup completes by 03:00. If it is still running at 03:00, the claim is wrong.

test_set.ainglish: Both replicas are consistent unless(<a checksum mismatch appears between them>).
test_set.english: Both replicas are consistent. Any checksum mismatch between them refutes that.

test_set.ainglish: The patch fixes the leak unless(<the memory graph still climbs after 24 hours>).
test_set.english: The patch fixes the leak. If the memory graph still climbs after 24 hours, it does not.
